messages:
Ava L: Heads up — need a quick sync on Convexity EBR next Tue. Execs want a 10-min readout + product demo. Can we confirm deck owners and action items?

Samir: I'm good to do the demo portion. Can someone own the exec readout slides (top 3 signals + renewal ask)?

Priya: I can take exec slides. Will pull health metrics and renewal risk summary. ETA EOD Fri.

Ben: I'll own deployment & onboarding slide, including recent perf numbers. Small ask: need a chart from eng — @eng-sre any chance for a latency trend export?

EBR-bot: Reminder: deck template v2 uploaded to Google Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/Convexity/EBR/template-v2.pptx (auto-reminder 48h before) :bell:

Samir: Thanks — pinged eng-sre. Also suggest we add a 'rollback story' slide showing fallback we used last month (helps execs trust the SLA).

Priya: Good call. I'll add a one-slide summary with timeline + impact numbers.

Ava L: Action items: Priya — health + renewal ask (due Fri EOD); Ben — onboarding + perf chart (due Thu); Samir — demo script + cue cards (due Mon); Ava — exec notes + region cost delta (due Mon).

Priya: Capturing feedback items from customer PM — will include two asks and open questions.

Ben: Quick Q: who will run the dry-run with execs? I can run a technical rehearsal with Eng, but want PM to attend the exec dry-run.

Ava L: Let's schedule a 30m dry-run Mon 10am PT. Ben run tech run 30m before. I'll invite PM and Sales.

Samir: Demo checklist (short): 1) start with problem statement, 2) run 2 use-cases, 3) show failover to smaller model, 4) zero-downtime deploy note.

Priya: Noted. Also adding a slide for cost vs quality tradeoffs requested by finance.

Ava L: Great. I'll collate slide owners and send final invite. Thanks team :raised_hands:
